141-3967-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3967-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-3967-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha, Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1626-3249-6723--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1626-3249-6723--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Headless Rider triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that Zombie from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.
728-1626-3249-6723--206.notes: Some of the one-drop Zombie creatures in the template adds more powerful results, and Gravecrawler does not require Havengul Lich.

967-1308-3809-4247-7087.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7338.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2728-4050-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-4050-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-4050-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-6664-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

215-2079-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-2079-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-4771-6972.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Repeat.

774-1671-5478.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Simic Growth Chamber's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1661-4871-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1661-4871-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

512-4241-7066.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-4241-7066.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

104-3490-5231-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-5231-5789.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

147-2921-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2921-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

413-2770-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

190-643-6860.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Maskwood Nexus and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Cast Suleiman's Legacy by paying {R}{W}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, destroying all Djinns and Efreets. Due to each opponent's Maskwood Nexus, this will result in all their creatures being destroyed.
Whenever an opponent has a creature enter, Suleiman's Legacy's second ability will trigger, destroying that creature.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5263-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from steps 1 and 3
Repeat.

851-1322-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-4055-5149-5516.easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
Power Artifact attached to Energy Refractor.
3525-4055-5149-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
3525-4055-5149-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

803-1429-5315-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-5315-5402.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

144-628-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing target player to mill cards equal to Ashcloud Phoenix's power for each ability.
Repeat.

500-914-3125-3967-4867.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
500-914-3125-3967-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dockside Extortionist and the token Cormela trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding four mana.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

215-654-2397-5647.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
215-654-2397-5647.description:
Cast Roxanne either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{R}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Roxanne enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Meteorite artifact token.
When the Meteorite enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger twice.
Resolve both Meteorite triggers, dealing 4 damage to any target.
Resolve the first Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the Meteorite.
Activate the Meteorite by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {R/G}.
Repeat from step 6 for the remaining Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Roxanne trigger.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Roxanne from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego tapping the Meteorites for mana and/or add mana of any color(s).

204-955-1858-2056-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-955-1858-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

2107-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Sunastian Falconer.
Sunastian Falconer does not have summoning sickness.
2107-3263-4222.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Sunastian Falconer.
Repeat.

3944-4311-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Mortuary triggers, putting Blood Pet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying {B}.
Repeat.
